Class InstrumentLogo

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.entities.BaseID<Integer>
grafiosch.entities.ProposeTransientTransfer
grafiosch.entities.Auditable
grafioschtrader.entities.InstrumentLogo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
@Entity public class InstrumentLogo extends Auditable implements Serializable
Shared catalog entry for a single company or issuer SVG logo. Deployed logos reference a static file under assets/company-logos/ via assetPath, while user-uploaded logos store sanitized SVG markup in svgContent. Multiple securities may reference the same entry (1:N).
